meta.name: demo-prep
meta.description: Prepare a customer demo or executive walkthrough around an evidenced outcome. Use before show-and-tell to rehearse the journey and prepare a fallback.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 彩排客户演示流程,并备好兜底方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果马上要向客户或高管做演示,担心现场出岔子。
copy.tagline_en: Rehearse the customer demo journey and prepare a fallback before showtime.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're about to demo to a customer or exec and want a backup plan.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会围绕一个有证据支撑的成果帮你准备客户演示或高管走查:提前排练演示路径,并准备一套备用方案。
howto.when: 在 show-and-tell 之前触发;若由 @fde 调用,则复用其当前已脱敏的上下文包与范围,不重启设置。

say.text: 帮我为明天的客户演示排练一遍演示路径
say.note: 围绕证据成果走一遍演示流程

say.text: 这次演示准备一个备用方案
say.note: 演示出问题时可以顶上

say.text: 梳理这次演示哪些环节已验证、哪些还没跑
say.note: 区分实现、验证、部署与验收

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude prepares a customer demo or executive walkthrough around an evidenced outcome: rehearsing the journey beforehand and preparing a fallback.
howto.when_en: Triggers before show-and-tell; when invoked by @fde it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup.

say_en.text: Rehearse the journey for tomorrow's customer demo with me
say_en.note: Walks the flow against the evidenced outcome

say_en.text: Prepare a fallback for this demo
say_en.note: Ready in case something breaks on stage

say_en.text: Sort out what's verified and what hasn't been run for this demo
